Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a right-sided pleural effusion and an anomalous vessel draining into the inferior vena cava (visible in Figure 1c), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly). In an adult presentation, this can manifest with dyspnea and right lung hypoplasia/effusion without necessarily having cardiomegaly.
